data.one_liner: A widget which implicitly launches a hero animation when its position changes within the same route.
data.what_it_does: Provides a LocalHero widget and LocalHeroScope that enables implicit hero animations when a widget changes its position or layout inside the same route. It tracks elements with unique tags and animates transitions smoothly based on the scope duration and curve.
use_when: You need to animate a widget's position change within the same screen or route.
You want a declarative way to create hero-like animations without navigating between different routes.
avoid_when: You are performing traditional page-to-page Hero transitions (Flutter's built-in Hero widget handles that).
You need multiple widgets with the same tag under the same LocalHeroScope at the same frame.
strengths: Brings hero-style animations to position changes within a single route.
Simple integration using a LocalHeroScope and LocalHero widgets.
weaknesses: Strict requirement to have only one LocalHero per tag per LocalHeroScope at each frame.
Limited documentation outside of basic playground examples.
data.minimal_example:
LocalHeroScope(
  duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
  curve: Curves.easeInOut,
  child: LocalHero(
    tag: 'my_widget_tag',
    child: MyWidget(),
  ),
)
